::: {.football-brief}
Senior production ML and applied AI experience, applied to football questions through tracking data, event data, reproducible modelling, visual explanation, and analyst-facing workflows that turn player, team, and academy questions into practical decision-support insight.
:::

## Project Links

::: {.project-link-list}
- [Pitch to the Pros 3: Was the Best Pass Really Playable?](projects/pitch-to-pros-3/): SkillCorner tracking/event data project adding decision-window context to pass value.
- [Support Creation Dynamics in Football](projects/support-creation-dynamics/): Research proposal for modelling how off-ball movement creates, improves, weakens, or removes support options.
- [Active Support Index: SkillCorner Analytics Cup Project](projects/asi/): Off-ball support metric for pressure events using SkillCorner tracking and dynamic event data.
- [Possession Foul-Win Probability Model](projects/foul-win-probability/): StatsBomb event-data project with possession labelling, calibrated XGBoost, SHAP review, and lift analysis.
- [Google Football with Manchester City](projects/kaggle-mancity/): Kaggle simulation project with Docker, local agent evaluation, and ML agent exploration.
:::
